summary: No findings. Untrusted input is a stored SessionReport read from IndexedDB, which can be tampered with. parseSessionReport -> parseHints (src/table/session-report.ts) checks that hints is a non-array object. It requires decisions to be a safe integer in 0..MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and hinted to be a safe integer in 0..decisions, using isWhole/Number.isSafeInteger with no type coercion. So NaN, Infinity, negatives, fractions, strings, values above 2^53 and hinted > decisions all fail with RangeError, the same way the other report fields already fail. Extra keys are ignored and never read: hintTile reads only hinted and decisions. hintTile guards decisions === 0, so the percentage is always finite and between 0 and 100. The tile is rendered as React text in <dt>/<dd> with no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, so no HTML or script injection is possible. A report that has hints but no errors passes validation but does not render the tile, because the tile sits inside the rates block. That is a display-consistency matter with no security impact. The change adds no new dependencies, network access, secrets or randomness.
